support.sprite:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 2D military pixel GAME SPRITE ATLAS. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, one whole vehicle in each cell, clear 20% transparent margins so no sprites touch any cell border. Truly transparent alpha backdrop, no checker pattern, no text/labels/grid/background. Uniform strict orthographic side view, front to RIGHT, crisp unmistakable coarse pixel clusters and jagged edges, realistic adult scale, muted olive/charcoal/desaturated tan. Match tank reference style. Canvas landscape 1536x1024 or proportional. Draw 4 DIFFERENT support vehicles. In each row first THREE cells are identical-size consecutive idle/driving frames (same hull, wheel/track anchors and body registration; only tread/wheel rotation differs); FOURTH cell is a separately drawn destroyed wreck of that row's vehicle. Wrecks are visibly structurally broken, no living crew, flames or smoke, not squashed intact sprites. Every frame completely inside its own cell.
ROW1 mobile mortar carrier: short open-topped olive SIX-WHEEL armored carrier, dark mortar tube pointing diagonally up from open rear fighting compartment, nose right, tyres clearly distinguished, compact size, no tank gun. Wreck: buckled six-wheel hull, snapped elevated mortar tube lying inside, ruined rear compartment.
ROW2 armored recovery vehicle: tracked armored chassis WITHOUT gun turret, compact rear service cabin and recognisable folded mechanical crane boom with hanging hook over body, engine toolboxes and winch; distinctive orange-brown tow cable. Wreck: ripped tracks, broken folded crane leaning across scorched hull, detached hook and cable near body.
ROW3 armored command vehicle: angular olive SIX-WHEEL armored van, taller closed cabin, TWO thin communications antennae and small folded radio dish, tiny defensive roof machinegun, no missile tubes. Wreck: open radio compartment, folded antenna mast, burnt cabin, broken wheel and hatch.
ROW4 armored mine-clearing vehicle: low squat TRACKED engineering chassis, very recognisable wide spiked steel mine-roller assembly projecting in FRONT to the RIGHT, small low machinegun cupola, no large cannon. Wreck: visibly detached bent mine rollers in front, burned tracked hull and tilted small cupola.
Consistent restrained olive equipment and deliberate pixel textures; keep substantial believable hull volume. No people anywhere, no cartoon toys, no smooth 3D. First 3 frames in each row preserve same size and anchors. Clear transparent gutters.
